1. Review the CONFIRMED_CORRUPT table above, then apply the corrections:

   python scripts/ops/corpus/ops_known_corrupt_print_cleanup.py --apply --symbols AMAT AMGN ARE ASYS BIIB BKD BRK.B BSX CVS ECH ETN EWA EWW EXEL FIX GEF HAL HUBB IDR IP IWO KCE KIE MOS MOV MSI OMC PATK PG SYY TDG TRST UHAL UNL UPS VTR WCC WY --tf 1d

2. IMPORTANT -- forward_returns and feature_vectors both insert with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (idempotent-replay semantics): re-running the writers below will NOT overwrite rows that already exist for the corrected neighborhood. Delete the stale rows first (widen the timestamp window to cover the corrected bar's forward-return lookahead plus any feature rolling-window lookback -- review before running):

   DELETE FROM forward_returns WHERE symbol IN ('AMAT', 'AMGN', 'ARE', 'ASYS', 'BIIB', 'BKD', 'BRK.B', 'BSX', 'CVS', 'ECH', 'ETN', 'EWA', 'EWW', 'EXEL', 'FIX', 'GEF', 'HAL', 'HUBB', 'IDR', 'IP', 'IWO', 'KCE', 'KIE', 'MOS', 'MOV', 'MSI', 'OMC', 'PATK', 'PG', 'SYY', 'TDG', 'TRST', 'UHAL', 'UNL', 'UPS', 'VTR', 'WCC', 'WY') AND tf IN ('1d') AND bar_ts BETWEEN <window_start> AND <window_end>;
   DELETE FROM feature_vectors WHERE symbol IN ('AMAT', 'AMGN', 'ARE', 'ASYS', 'BIIB', 'BKD', 'BRK.B', 'BSX', 'CVS', 'ECH', 'ETN', 'EWA', 'EWW', 'EXEL', 'FIX', 'GEF', 'HAL', 'HUBB', 'IDR', 'IP', 'IWO', 'KCE', 'KIE', 'MOS', 'MOV', 'MSI', 'OMC', 'PATK', 'PG', 'SYY', 'TDG', 'TRST', 'UHAL', 'UNL', 'UPS', 'VTR', 'WCC', 'WY') AND tf IN ('1d') AND bar_ts BETWEEN <window_start> AND <window_end>;

   python services/forward_return_writer.py --symbols AMAT AMGN ARE ASYS BIIB BKD BRK.B BSX CVS ECH ETN EWA EWW EXEL FIX GEF HAL HUBB IDR IP IWO KCE KIE MOS MOV MSI OMC PATK PG SYY TDG TRST UHAL UNL UPS VTR WCC WY --tf 1d --training-window-end 2025-12-24T05:15:00Z
